name: touch
summary: Change file timestamps or create empty files.
description: Update the access and modification times of each FILE to the current time. A FILE argument that does not exist is created empty.

options.description: Use specified timestamp instead of current time.

examples.title: Create a new empty file
examples.explanation: Creates index.ts if it does not exist.

examples.title: Update modification timestamp
examples.explanation: Updates script.sh last modified timestamp to current time.
